summary.text: Tano Tijerina is the Webb County Judge, a post he has held since 2015, and the Republican nominee in Texas's 28th District. A former minor league baseball player and rancher, he was elected county judge as a Democrat and switched to the Republican Party in December 2024. He won the March 2026 Republican primary and is running on border security, affordability and public safety.

paragraphs.text: Earned a bachelor's degree in fitness and sports from Texas A&M International University.
Played minor league baseball and worked in the ranching industry before his judgeship; Ballotpedia also lists him as executive vice president of the Precept Ministries Spanish Board.

Elected Webb County Judge in 2014 as a Democrat and took office in 2015; he won re-election in 2018 (76.3% against Republican Alfonso Casso) and in 2022 (no general election was held after he advanced from the Democratic primary unopposed).
Switched to the Republican Party in December 2024, saying, according to the Texas Tribune, that the Democratic Party no longer aligned with his values.
Announced his campaign for Congress on December 2, 2025; his third term as county judge runs through December 31, 2026.
Won the March 3, 2026 Republican primary with 74.3% of the vote over Eileen Day.
Says his record as county judge includes cutting property taxes five times, delivering $20 million in utility relief, and expanding healthcare access in Webb County.

sources.title: Webb County Judge Tano Tijerina launches run for Congress, seeking to flip South Texas district red
